games.title: Dragon Ball Z: Team Training
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version 7.0 COMPLETED. Dragon Ball Z: Team Training is one of the most beloved crossover ROM hacks ever made. Built on Pokémon Fire Red, it replaces every Pokémon in the game with Dragon Ball Z characters — from Goku and Vegeta as starters to Frieza, Cell, and Buu as boss encounters. Version 7.0 is the final and complete version. The hack retains the familiar Pokémon battle system while completely reimagining the roster. You'll build a team of Z Fighters, power them up like the iconic characters from the anime, and battle your way through Kanto with a DBZ twist. The stats, moves, and type matchups are redesigned to reflect each character's abilities from the series. DBZ: Team Training is perfect for fans of both Pokémon and Dragon Ball Z who want to experience their favorite characters in a new way. The fully completed version 7.0 is polished, widely compatible, and easy to pick up regardless of whether you're a Pokémon veteran or a Dragon Ball fan first.

games.title: Pocket Gaiden
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 2.0. Pocket Gaiden is one of the most original GBA ROM hacks available — a fully story-driven adventure built on Pokemon Emerald that ditches the standard trainer-journey template entirely. You play as Pulp, a berry farmer in an unnamed China-inspired region who just wants to move his business to Honzhu City. His truck is broken, resources are tight, and the path ahead runs through dense wilderness and enigmatic Color Ruins where even basic supplies like Poké Balls are rare and valuable. The game's tone is grounded and deliberate. This is not a power fantasy — it's a survival story. Resource scarcity is a core design element, and the challenge comes as much from managing what little you have as from the battles themselves. Boss trainers have enhanced statistics, and every encounter counts when you're rationing your supplies. Version 2.0 is a substantial update over the original release. New areas — Xilong Walk, Wangyong Marsh, Tiyu Forest, Kimyang Road, and Zhaoun Path — expand the world wi

games.title: Pokemon Advanced Adventure
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Leaf Green. Version 2018. Pokemon Advanced Adventure is a Leaf Green hack that flips the traditional Pokémon power fantasy on its head. You play not as a privileged trainer with a wealthy benefactor, but as the poorest kid in town — bullied, friendless, and with no path to ever owning a Pokémon. That changes when the professor's own grandson seizes control of the Pokémon League and forces you into action. The hack is praised for its gritty, emotionally resonant story — a stark contrast to the optimism of mainline Pokémon games. You'll face 8 subordinates, defeat genetically modified rogue Pokémon, and ultimately challenge the corrupted Pokémon Headquarters in a narrative that explores themes of class, power, and justice. Pokemon Advanced Adventure was one of the most popular story-driven GBA hacks of its era and remains a must-play for fans who want something with more emotional depth than the base games. The difficulty is tuned to be challenging, with beefed-up trainers and some notably tough boss battles.

games.title: Pokemon Adventure Blue Chapter
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Beta 1.1. Pokémon Adventure Blue Chapter follows Blue (Red's rival from Pallet) as he returns from Johto training to follow in his grandfather Professor Oak's footsteps and claim the Kanto Championship. Quickly becoming rivals with Red, Blue must set personal competition aside when Team Rocket threatens those he cares about. Blue's story adds the rival's perspective to the Adventure series — confident, skilled, and ultimately more vulnerable than he lets on. Beta 1.1 covers the beginning of Blue's arc.

games.title: Pokemon Adventure Green Chapter
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Beta 3. Pokémon Adventure Green Chapter follows Green (the girl from Pallet Town who was kidnapped by Moltres as a child) as she returns home years later to discover life has moved on without her. Enraged and lost, she pursues revenge on those who took her away — including Team Rocket — in a spinoff of Red Chapter. Green's story is one of the more emotionally complex in the Adventures manga, and this game captures her scheming, resourceful personality well. Beta 3 is the available version.

games.title: Pokemon Adventure Red Chapter
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Beta 15. Pokémon Adventure Red Chapter is one of the most faithful and beloved manga adaptations in ROM hack history. Based on the Pokémon Adventures manga arc featuring Red, it recreates 116 events from the manga (plus two movie events) as a playable GBA game — letting you catch the same Pokémon Red catches, make the decisions he makes, and experience the story you read on paper as an actual adventure. Creator Aethstode has gone to remarkable lengths to recreate manga panels as game events, and the result is surprisingly cinematic for a GBA ROM hack. The game follows the Kanto manga arc with Team Rocket and the expanded cast of characters fans know from the comics. Beta 15 is the most recent release, covering a substantial portion of the manga.

games.title: Pokemon Adventure Yellow Chapter
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Demo. Pokémon Adventure Yellow Chapter follows the Yellow arc of the Pokémon Adventures manga — set two years after the Saffron City battle, as Yellow sets out to find the missing Red using his own Pikachu. The story stays close to the manga, with some events expanded to fill out the gameplay. Aethstode's characteristic faithfulness to the source material is evident. Yellow's story has a different emotional tone than Red's — more mystery and searching than direct confrontation — and the game captures that atmosphere well.

games.title: Pokemon Ash Gray
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 4.5.3. Pokémon Ash Gray is the ultimate anime-to-game adaptation: you play as Ash Ketchum through 116 faithfully recreated events from the original Pokémon anime, plus two movie events. You catch the exact Pokémon Ash catches, make the same choices he makes, and experience the first season of the show as a playable adventure. Creator metapod23 has done extraordinary work translating anime scenes into game events — Ash waking up late and getting Pikachu as a last resort, the battles with Brock and Misty, Team Rocket encounters, and major story moments all play out recognizably. The game starts with a character-select screen but Pikachu is your partner regardless of who you choose, in true anime fashion. For players who grew up watching the original series, Ash Gray is an emotional and nostalgic experience unlike any other ROM hack.

games.title: Pokemon CAWPS
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 1.0 Complete. Pokémon CAWPS is Crizzle's Emerald-based follow-up to Outlaw, this time set in a more realistic (read: chaotic) version of the Hoenn region. You play as a young man or woman who becomes a Police Officer — a premise that flips the typical Pokémon trainer fantasy and grounds the adventure in a gritty, adult-humor-driven world. The tone is toned down compared to Outlaw's most extreme moments, but CAWPS retains the same dark comedy, NPC weirdness, and mature undercurrent. Violence, death, and moral ambiguity are present throughout. It's a complete game and a solid entry in Crizzle's unofficial adult Pokémon trilogy. Warning: Contains violence, dark themes, and adult humor. Not appropriate for children.

games.title: Pokemon Celia's Stupid
games.description: Base game: Pokémon FireRed. Version 1.1.1. Pokemon Celia's Stupid is a ROM hack of Pokemon FireRed that throws the usual adventure formula out the window in favor of comedy, trivia, and puzzles. Created by CeliaDawn, the hack was originally built for playing with friends — the creator recommends running it over a Discord call, arguing over answers together rather than grinding through it solo. The writing is the centerpiece. Every NPC in the game has been given new dialogue, and hidden within those conversations are clues that feed into the hack's puzzles. Nothing is there just for flavor — paying attention to what characters say is part of how you progress. An in-game hint system is available when you get stuck, keeping things from turning into a frustrating dead end. Custom art and custom music back up the rewritten world, giving the hack its own distinct look and sound rather than relying on FireRed's defaults. The Pokedex has also been reworked as part of gameplay — completing it is encouraged as something meaningful rather

games.title: Pokemon Chaos Black
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Complete. Pokémon Chaos Black is one of the most notorious ROM hacks in community history — infamous as the centerpiece of a 2009 internet hoax where it was presented as a real unreleased Nintendo game, fooling thousands of players. The "fakemon" Balista and mysterious Pokégods added to the mythology. As an actual hack, Chaos Black takes place in the new Beaulés region west of Magore, where you chase powerful creatures called Pokégods while Eseal of the Se Corp empire pursues them for domination. It's a curiosity piece as much as a game — interesting for its role in ROM hack history even if the gameplay itself is simple by modern standards.

games.title: Pokemon Cloud White
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version .515. Pokemon Cloud White is one of the most ambitious multi-region GBA ROM hacks ever attempted. It begins with the classic FireRed storyline in Kanto, but once you complete that chapter, the game opens up into an entirely new adventure spanning five separate regions — offering dozens of additional hours of post-game content. Created by Shogun, Cloud White is known for its sheer scope. The five regions are all custom-designed with new maps, trainers, gyms, and stories. You'll encounter Pokémon from multiple generations throughout your journey, and the scale of the post-game alone puts many commercial Pokémon games to shame. While the pacing can be uneven at times due to its enormous scale, Pokemon Cloud White is a bucket-list hack for fans who want the longest possible GBA Pokémon experience. If you've ever wanted a single GBA ROM that keeps giving, Cloud White delivers.

games.title: Pokemon Clover
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Complete. Pokémon Clover is one of the most notorious ROM hacks in the community — a FireRed-based game set in the Fochun region, populated entirely by 386 completely original Fakemon designed in an intentionally absurdist, internet-culture-influenced style. The game originated from 4chan's /vp/ board and carries that community's particular brand of irreverent humor throughout. Under the meme-soaked surface, Clover is a genuinely well-made difficulty hack. The Fakemon are mechanically interesting with clever designs, the level curve is challenging, and the game is packed with content including a full post-game. Team Karma makes a compelling antagonist faction, and the Fochun region is larger and more varied than most fan-made regions. Note: Pokémon Clover contains internet humor that some may find offensive. It's not family-friendly. But for players who enjoy a challenge and appreciate its particular sense of humor, it's a deeply enjoyable game.

games.title: Pokémon Crossroads
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version Beta 1.1. Pokémon Crossroads is the ROM hack that fans have dreamed about for decades: a single GBA game that lets you play through both Pokémon Emerald and Pokémon FireRed, back to back, in one seamless adventure. Built on the pokeemerald-expansion engine, it merges Hoenn, Kanto, and the Sevii Islands into one connected world with 16 Gym Badges to collect. The most unique feature is the dual starting option. At the boot screen, simply press SELECT to choose whether you begin your journey in Pallet Town (FireRed story) or Littleroot Town (Emerald story). Either way, you'll eventually explore both regions by traveling between them via the Pokémon Centers in Viridian City and Oldale Town. Pokémon Crossroads is a passion project from a dedicated development team, and the polish shows. Custom multi-region warp, flag, and event systems ensure that both storylines progress correctly no matter which order you tackle them. The game is compatible with all major emulators including mGBA, Delta, Pizza Boy

games.title: Pokemon Crush
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Ruby. Version 1.7. Pokémon Crush is a Ruby hack with a deeply original premise rooted in emotional storytelling. The game opens with a lengthy prologue about a caregiver and his Marowak — a tale of jealousy, rejection, and revenge that sets the emotional stakes for the adventure ahead. Years later, the consequences of that story shape the world you explore. Creator RedMort built something genuinely different: a ROM hack where the backstory is the emotional core, and the adventure is about uncovering what happened and why. The writing is stronger than most hacks in this collection, and the Ruby Pokémon Crush's focus on narrative over mechanical complexity makes it a thoughtful, memorable experience.

games.title: Pokémon Crystal Advance Redux
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version 24-3-24. Pokémon Crystal Advance Redux is a layered, history-rich ROM hack that started as Pokémon Liquid Crystal, was reworked into Pokémon Crystal Advance by Kertra, and then substantially rebuilt by Arnie into what it is today. The result is something unique: a GBA-rendered demake of Pokémon Crystal with the soul of HeartGold/SoulSilver and a generous helping of new content. The highlights include a fully implemented day/night/seasons system with proper night lighting and time-of-day battle backgrounds, 553 Pokémon visible in the Pokédex including Gen 3/4 and regional variants, and music remastered from Pokémon Stadium 2 in higher bitrate. Every GBA track in the game has a corresponding GB Player variant. Trade evolutions are replaced with held item level-up evolutions. The Fairy type, Sylveon, and most Fairy moves from Gen 6 are included. Physical/Special split is present. Shiny odds are 1/256, and Celadon's Game Corner has a machine for a random Shiny encounter. For difficulty enthusiasts:

games.title: Pokemon Crystal Dust
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version v3.0.0-alpha. Pokémon Crystal Dust is a GBA remake of Pokémon Crystal, converting the beloved GBC game's visuals and gameplay into the GBA engine while preserving the complete Johto adventure. Play as Gold or Kris through the full Crystal storyline with improved graphics, smoother gameplay, and all the content fans remember. This is one of the earlier attempts at a faithful Crystal demake and remains well-regarded for how closely it reproduces the original experience with better visuals. A great choice for players who want to revisit Johto in GBA-era quality.

games.title: Pokemon Cyan
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Beta 3. Pokémon Cyan is a FireRed hack set in the tropical Celia archipelago, featuring original maps, a mix of official Pokémon and high-quality Fakemon, and a decision-based storyline. When Team Rocket — resurrected by Giovanni — launches an attack on Celia and begins making Pokémon disappear, your 12th birthday journey becomes a battle to save the region. The standout feature is player agency: you can choose whether to join Team Rocket or oppose them, with meaningful branching based on your decisions. The Celia archipelago features updated graphics, an island-hopping world structure, and one of the more compelling stories in FireRed-based hacks.

games.title: Pokemon Dark Rising
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Complete. Pokémon Dark Rising is one of the most popular FireRed hacks ever made and kickstarted DarkRisingGirl's celebrated series. You wake from a dream in which a mysterious Pokémon asks for your help to save the world from the dark force DARUGIS — and the adventure that follows is anything but simple. Dark Rising is known for its high difficulty, its Dragon-type starter Pokémon, its crossover cast featuring characters from multiple games and anime, and a story packed with escalating stakes. Pokémon from multiple generations are available, and the game features a battle system upgraded beyond vanilla FireRed with stronger AI. Dark Rising 1 established the series' reputation for genuinely challenging boss battles and memorable storytelling. It remains a fan favorite more than a decade after its original release.

games.title: Pokemon Dark Rising 2
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Complete. Pokémon Dark Rising 2 picks up directly after the events of Dark Rising 1, moving the action to the Omni Region as you and Team Dark Rising pursue Darugis and search for your captured father. The story escalates significantly from the first game — new characters join your party, old rivals become allies, and the mysteries of the "Three Chosen Ones" deepen. DR2 builds on everything that made the first game beloved: Dragon-type starters, challenging boss battles, crossover characters (including a rematch with Ash Ketchum himself), and a story that keeps raising the stakes. It's longer and more expansive than the first game with a more developed cast and more ambitious set pieces.

games.title: Pokemon Dark Rising Order Destroyed
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Complete. Pokémon Dark Rising: Order Destroyed bridges the gap between Dark Rising 2 and the upcoming Dark Rising 3. The tagline — "There Is No Order. There Is Only… Hoopa" — hints at the chaotic energy this short entry brings. It reveals the truth behind Dark Rising 2's conclusion and sets the stage for the next chapter in the series. Order Destroyed is shorter than the main Dark Rising games and functions primarily as a narrative link, but it delivers the series' signature high-stakes storytelling and challenging battles.

games.title: Pokemon Dark Rising Origins Worlds Collide
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Complete. Pokémon Dark Rising Origins: Worlds Collide is the most ambitious entry in DarkRisingGirl's series — a crossover between the Pokémon and Digimon universes. Set in the Ferrum Region, digital monsters called Digimon have merged their data with Pokémon DNA, and you join the elite Team Dark Rising to investigate and defeat the 7 Great Demon Lords unleashed by the Satan Pokémon, Darugis. The mashup premise is executed with genuine enthusiasm, and the game delivers the same high-difficulty battles and story drama that defined the earlier Dark Rising games. It's a standalone entry that doesn't require completion of the previous games to enjoy.

games.title: Pokemon Dark Violet
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Complete. Pokémon Dark Violet is Chaos Rush's personal reimagining of Pokémon Red & Green — not a remake like FireRed/LeafGreen, but a complete reboot. Think of it as Chaos Rush's "Generation I" — the Kanto adventure as it would be designed today, modernized and re-envisioned rather than simply upgraded. The game uses the FireRed engine but is not a Gen III hack in spirit. New maps, reworked dialogue, updated character motivations, and a distinctly different tone make it feel fresh. It's a complete game and a thoughtful exercise in what the original Pokémon games might have been with modern game design sensibilities.

games.title: Pokémon Dark Worship
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version 2.8. A Fire Red Hack with a New Region, New Story, Mega Evolution, Z Moves, Dynamax/Gigantamax, YouTubers as NPCs & Much More! Dark Worship is a hack with its own story that takes place in the Seafood Region. An Evil Sect invades the region to try to capture the Holy Pokémon. Do they intend to do any harm to the Pokémon world? Our protagonist will go on a journey to win the title of champion of the Seafood Region. On your adventure, you will meet familiar characters from other games, make friends, and battle against the terrible Sect of Evil.

games.title: Pokemon Digimon Operation Digipedia
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Alpha. Pokémon Digimon Operation Digipedia replaces every Pokémon in the game with Digimon, creating a unique crossover experience on GBA hardware. You play as a Tamer in a world where Digimon are kept as pets, investigating a dangerous disturbance alongside your rival. The game introduces a Digicard system for teaching moves, Digi Modify Cards for stat boosts, and Key Cards for unlocking doors and events. It's an Alpha release, so the content is limited, but the premise is executed with genuine creativity. For fans of both franchises who have always wanted to pit Agumon against Gabumon in a turn-based RPG, this delivers that fantasy.

games.title: Pokemon Dreary
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Complete. Pokemon Dreary is a short but atmospheric FireRed hack that transforms Kanto into a place of dread. Something is deeply wrong with the region — mysterious phenomena, an oppressive tone, and a growing sense that the world you know is unraveling. Your goal is simple and urgent: reach the Indigo Plateau before it's too late. Dreary is praised for its atmosphere above all else. Anthroyd uses the FireRed engine to create an unsettling, melancholy experience that feels genuinely different from a standard Pokémon playthrough. The writing and environmental storytelling are the highlights. As a shorter hack, Dreary is perfect for players who want a complete, focused experience without a 20-hour time investment. It's a great example of what a single dedicated creator can achieve with the FireRed base — and a compelling case for the horror/mystery subgenre within Pokémon ROM hacking.

games.title: Pokemon Eclipse
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Beta 1. Pokemon Eclipse is a FireRed hack set in the Soala region — a land with a pastoral atmosphere that quickly descends into mystery. You start as the child of Mareep farmers in Lapis Village, dreaming of joining the Ace Trainers, an elite division of the Devon Corporation. But something is wrong: wild Pokémon are becoming violent, townsfolk report illusions and mirages, and a gang of thieves is sowing chaos across the region. Eclipse stands out for its atmospheric world-building and engaging mystery narrative. The Soala region feels lived-in and distinct from Kanto, with custom maps, NPCs, and events that build toward a satisfying reveal of what's causing the disturbances. While currently in Beta 1, the released content is polished and offers several hours of gameplay. Fans of mystery-driven hacks and those who enjoy custom-region adventures will find Eclipse a rewarding playthrough.

games.title: Pokemon Emerald Azure
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 0.4.3.1. Pokemon Emerald Azure is an ambitious, difficulty-focused ROM hack of Pokemon Emerald built by Kacey with a completely original story set in a reimagined Hoenn. The hack draws on the Radical Red dex framework — bringing across all of its stat changes, ability overhauls, and movepool updates — and layers on top of it a wealth of original content and a demanding challenge system designed specifically for experienced players. The Pokémon roster has been massively expanded. 116 custom variant forms with their own evolutions, 9 brand-new Eeveelutions, and 26 new Mega Evolutions join the existing pool of Pokémon from Generations 1–9. Custom signature moves and abilities have been created for specific Pokémon, giving team-building a genuinely fresh dimension even for players who know the Radical Red dex inside out. Difficulty is thoughtfully designed rather than arbitrarily punishing. SET mode is forced, healing items are banned in trainer battles, and enemy teams are EV-trained at level caps

games.title: Pokémon Emerald Crest
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 1.0.F. Pokémon Emerald Crest takes the beloved Hoenn story and layers it with a comprehensive suite of modern Pokémon features from Gens 1 through 9. If you've ever wanted to play vanilla Emerald but with every quality-of-life and mechanical upgrade from the last two decades, this is it. The feature list is long and impressive: Mega Evolutions, Primal Forms, Alolan/Galarian/Hisuian forms, DexNav, Soaring, Wild Bosses, Chain Fishing, all move types and moves through Gen 9, a reusable TMs, a Quest Menu, Auto Run, Gen 6-style Exp Share, and a Teleport Service that eliminates backtracking. The Pokédex Plus system gives you enhanced information on every Pokémon. Emerald Crest is actively maintained with regular updates (currently version 1.0.F), making it one of the most up-to-date active Emerald enhancement hacks available. It's a great choice if you want the full Emerald story with every modern convenience.

games.title: Pokémon Emerald Imperium
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 1.1. This is a difficulty/QoL hack of Pokémon Emerald that is fully complete and beatable through the Champion battle with some post-game content. iriv24's goal in creating this hack was pretty simple: I wanted to create an experience in Emerald that is as close to the experience that Pokemon Radical Red delivers as possible by porting all of the balance changes from RR into a new game and by creating a whole bunch of new battles with increased difficulty. These balance changes include new abilities, stat changes, type changes, learnset changes, evolution method changes, etc. I want to be clear here that I am NOT affiliated with RR in any capacity; I am merely a person who has spent many hours playing RR, and who, like many other romhack players I've encountered, wished for more games just like it in other regions. I want to give full credit to its creators for all of the ideas behind the balance changes mentioned, QoL changes, and many other features that I brought over into this game. Wit

games.title: Pokémon Emerald Mini
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 1.2.2. Pokémon Emerald Mini is the answer to "what if Pokémon Emerald were faster?" It keeps the beloved Hoenn region and third-generation feel but compresses the journey — fewer required areas, tighter pacing, and a streamlined story that cuts the fluff without cutting the fun. The game is designed for players who want the Hoenn experience without a 30+ hour commitment, or for veterans who want a quick nostalgic run. Despite being "mini," it includes an expanded post-game where you can catch all 386 Pokémon — so there's still plenty to do after the credits roll. With helpful quality-of-life features throughout, Emerald Mini is also a great starting point for players new to ROM hacks or to Pokémon in general. It's fully complete at version 1.0.10.

games.title: Pokémon Emerald Rogue 2.1 EX
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 2.1.1. Pokémon Emerald Rogue 2.1 EX is the definitive roguelike Pokémon experience on GBA. Developed by Pokabbie, it transforms Pokémon Emerald into a run-based game where every attempt is unique: all routes, wild encounters, and items are procedurally generated based on your progress, and if you wipe out, you start fresh from a hub world. A full run takes roughly 3–4 hours of in-game time. Each run ends when you either defeat the Champion or lose all your Pokémon. After each run — win or lose — you return to the hub area, where you spend currency to unlock permanent upgrades, new buildings, and additional NPCs that help prepare your next attempt. The Safari Zone acts as a Pokémon storage system, letting you bank Pokémon you've used in previous runs to use as starters in future ones. The EX edition includes the Fairy type, the physical/special split, and newer generation abilities and mechanics — making it the recommended version over standard Vanilla. Shinies appear at roughly 1-in-100, trad

games.title: Pokémon Emerald Seaglass
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 3.0. Pokémon Emerald Seaglass is the coziest ROM hack in this collection. Nemo622 took Pokémon Emerald and gave it a gorgeous Game Boy Color-inspired visual makeover — soft, desaturated palettes, retro-style tiles, and updated battle backgrounds that evoke nostalgia while looking completely fresh. Under the hood, Seaglass is packed with content. All Pokémon from Generations 1–3 are available, plus cross-generation evolutions like Roserade, Mamoswine, and Farigiraf. Several weaker Pokémon have been given new type combinations to make them more viable — Ghost/Flying Noctowl, Grass/Dragon Sceptile, and Water/Fire Octillery are just a few examples. The Physical/Special split and Fairy type are both present. The game introduces genuinely new activities: a Scuba Diving competition in Pacifidlog Town, Pinball mini-games that unlock rare items and Alolan Eggs, and the Rustboro City Wishing Well — a gacha-style system where you spend Wishing Stars (found exploring or purchasable later) to receive a

games.title: Pokemon Energized Emerald
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 1.1.5. Pokemon Energized Emerald is a comprehensive enhancement hack of Pokemon Emerald by Land0fChocolate that keeps the soul of the original while upgrading nearly every system. The goal is a faithful but expanded Hoenn — more to explore, more to catch, and deeper battles — without abandoning what made Emerald great. The standout mechanical feature is multi-ability: Pokémon can possess up to three concurrent abilities at once, fundamentally changing how battles play out. New abilities have been woven into the existing roster — Gulpin gains Corrosion, Whismur gets Volume Up — and new moves like Singularity (exclusive to Gardevoir) add further depth. The result is a battle system that feels familiar but rewards creative team-building in new ways. The story has been revised to incorporate ORAS elements alongside a post-League continuation, giving the game a meaningful endgame beyond the Champion. The overworld has been expanded with new urban areas, complex dungeons, and entirely new zones to

games.title: Pokémon Evolved
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Leaf Green. Version 1.0. Pokémon Evolved is a fascinating concept executed well: take all 151 original Kanto Pokémon, give each of them two additional evolutions, and you end up with 354 unique Pokémon to discover. Every new evolution comes with custom front and back sprites, its own Pokédex entry, a shiny variant, and completely reworked stats and movesets to match. The game is based on Pokémon Leaf Green and uses the familiar Kanto region and story, but every route encounter has been modified to ensure all Gen I Pokémon (and their new evolutions) are findable and catchable in a single playthrough. Notable quality-of-life improvements include Infinite Rare Candies in the PC, EXP Share on by default, a physical/special split, and all evolutionary stones available for purchase in Celadon City. Trade evolutions and friendship evolutions have been converted to level-up evolutions so you never need a second device. Stone evolutions remain intact. The game is designed to be played in gym order for balanced difficul

games.title: Pokemon Fire of Sky
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 1.0.3. Pokemon Fire of Sky takes a very different approach to the usual Emerald hack formula. Built on the pokeemerald-expansion engine, it strips away the familiar trainer-journey structure entirely and drops you into a world that exists long before Poke Balls, gyms, or professional trainers were ever invented. You play as Renji, a young villager whose constant companion is a Growlithe that follows you everywhere across the overworld — through towns, routes, and the wilderness alike. When a wave of unexplained aggression begins spreading through the region's wild Pokemon, turning ordinary creatures hostile, Renji sets out to find the source of the disturbance and bring things back to normal. With no trainer battles to speak of, the entire game revolves around wild encounters and exploration. Progress comes from venturing into new areas, fighting wild Pokemon along the way, and tracking down hidden items scattered throughout the world. A passive healing system gradually restores your team's H

games.title: Pokemon Fire Red Omega
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Complete. Pokémon Fire Red Omega is one of the first and most well-known enhancement hacks by prolific ROM hacker Drayano. The philosophy is simple: improve FireRed in every way without changing the story. All 386 Pokémon are available, new wild encounter locations give each route more variety, additional trainers increase the challenge, and new areas add content without disrupting the familiar Kanto flow. Drayano's characteristic quality — careful balancing, clean implementation, and a commitment to making every Pokémon viable — is evident throughout. Fire Red Omega predates his later, more famous works (Renegade Platinum, Sacred Gold) but remains a solid benchmark for the enhancement hack genre.

games.title: Pokemon Flora Sky
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version Complete. Pokémon Flora Sky is a classic Emerald-based hack featuring an original story set in a new region where Giratina's escape from the Distortion World has opened a portal bringing chaos to the land. Team Magma and Aqua are pursuing legendary Fire and Water Pokémon in the crisis, and you must prevent them from disrupting the balance between Groudon, Kyogre, and Giratina's influence. Flora Sky is beloved for its quality world-building, new areas to explore, Pokémon from multiple generations, and a story that weaves elements from Diamond/Pearl into the Emerald engine. It's a complete game with a satisfying narrative arc and one of the more polished custom-region Emerald hacks available.

games.title: Pokemon Fuligin
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Complete. Pokemon Fuligin is one of the most beloved Team Rocket perspective hacks ever made. Created by Sloo (also of Giratina Strikes Back fame), Fuligin starts like a standard FireRed adventure before pulling the rug out: your brother is a Team Rocket member, and he drags you along for the ride — and eventually, you rise to lead the organization yourself. What makes Fuligin special is its moral ambiguity. You're not the typical hero saving the world — you're climbing the ranks of a criminal organization while two rogue Pokémon with world domination aspirations create chaos in the background. The dual-threat narrative keeps the story tense and engaging throughout. As a fully complete hack, Pokemon Fuligin offers a tight, focused experience from start to finish. It's a perfect choice for players who want a fresh perspective on the GBA Pokémon formula and enjoy stories where the line between protagonist and villain is deliberately blurred.

games.title: Pokémon Fused Dimensions
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version 2.3. Pokémon Fused Dimensions is a showcase hack by DanteZ.35 built around a single jaw-dropping concept: every Pokémon in the game is a fusion of two existing Pokémon. The 376-strong Pokédex is filled entirely with original fusion designs — dual-type, dual-aesthetic creations that are unlike anything in a mainline Pokémon game. The story follows the Fire Red plot through a modified Kanto, but the Gym Leaders, Elite Four, and Champion all use custom fusion Pokémon, and some fusions even have their own Mega Evolutions. Custom Pokédex entries and base stats accompany every fusion, making each discovery feel substantial. Several QoL upgrades round out the experience: Forgettable HMs, Infinite TMs, a Physical/Special split, the Fairy type, shiny odds set to 1/257, a Link Cable item to replace trade evolutions, and a Move Relearner in every Pokémon Center. If you want to see some of the most creative Pokémon designs ever made in a ROM hack, Fused Dimensions is a must-play.

games.title: Pokemon Gaia
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Beta 3.2. Pokémon Gaia is universally regarded as one of the best-crafted GBA ROM hacks ever released. Developed by Spherical Ice with exceptional attention to detail, it takes place in the brand-new Orbtus region — a land steeped in ancient history, where a prosperous civilization mysteriously vanished after catastrophic earthquakes, leaving only temples and stone idols behind. You're recruited by Professor Redwood to investigate escalating seismic activity threatening the region. The story unfolds across a polished 20–30 hour adventure filled with clever puzzles, memorable characters, and a narrative that keeps building right up to the end. Gaia is notable for its production values — custom tiles, updated sprites, Gen 4 and 5 Pokémon available, Fairy type, Physical/Special split, mega evolution, underwater environments, rock climbing, and gen 6-style running shoes. It's one of the few ROM hacks that genuinely feels like an official Nintendo product in terms of polish and playability.

games.title: Pokemon Genesis
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Complete. Pokemon Genesis is a FireRed hack set in the Serao region, built around a compelling moral question: when the line between good and evil becomes blurred, which side do you choose? You play as the child of a lead scientist at Uriel Enterprises — a corporation that was once celebrated for its philanthropy but has now become shrouded in controversy over unexplained spending. The game opens quietly: your father asks you to pick up a parcel from a neighboring city. Along the way you encounter a strangely familiar woman who leaves abruptly. From there, the conspiracy unravels gradually, drawing you into a web of corporate corruption, ancient Pokémon mythology (the opening quotes the creation legend directly), and moral ambiguity that distinguishes Genesis from lighter fare. Pokemon Genesis is fully complete and represents a high-water mark in story-driven GBA ROM hacking. The writing is mature without being edgy, the Serao region is fully realized, and the narrative structure rewards attenti

games.title: Pokemon Giratina Strikes Back
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Complete. Pokemon Giratina Strikes Back is a completed FireRed hack by Sloo — the same creator behind Pokemon Fuligin. Set in the original Lunoh Region, you play as the child of a wealthy industrialist who gifts you an Eevee and sends you off to fulfill his dream of becoming a Pokémon Master. What begins as a coming-of-age journey quickly escalates as Team Genesis emerges with a terrifying plan: free Giratina from the Distortion World and harness its power for global domination. You'll travel through Lunoh's gyms, uncover the organization's schemes, and ultimately face Giratina itself in a climactic battle. As a fully complete hack, Pokemon Giratina Strikes Back offers a polished start-to-finish experience with a custom region, original NPCs, and a story that pays homage to the Sinnoh mythology in a GBA setting. Fans of Sloo's other work (Fuligin) will find a similar tone: story-driven, atmospheric, and satisfying to complete.

games.title: Pokemon Glazed
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 9.1.0. Pokémon Glazed is one of the most beloved fan-made Pokémon games ever made, and a cornerstone of the ROM hack community. Set in the brand-new Tunod region (with later access to Johto and the Rankor Archipelago), it features a completely original story: a mysterious force is causing a collision between the Pokémon world and the real world, and only you can stop it. What makes Glazed stand out is the sheer scope of the adventure. Three regions to explore, five starters to choose from, Pokémon up through Gen 5, a memorable cast of characters including a scarfed Pikachu bent on revenge, and a story full of twists and turns that keeps the player invested for 40+ hours. Glazed is a foundational ROM hack — the kind that shows what the medium is capable of when the creator is passionate and dedicated. It's essential playing for anyone interested in GBA Pokémon ROM hacks.

games.title: Pokemon Hoenn's Last Wish
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 0.3.19. Pokemon Hoenn's Last Wish is a dark, narrative-driven ROM hack of Pokemon Emerald built on the pokeemerald-expansion decompilation framework. The premise diverges sharply from vanilla Emerald: Rayquaza never intervened, Groudon and Kyogre unleashed their full power, and the Hoenn region was destroyed. Survivors from this ruined future — morally ambiguous and desperate — now rely on you to travel back in time and stop the catastrophe before it happens. The hack introduces mutant Pokemon forms, custom sprites born from the chaos of the fractured timeline, and a completely reimagined cast of Gym Leaders and antagonists. Familiar Hoenn locations are altered and distorted, reflecting the consequences of a world on the edge of collapse. The story is the centerpiece — every design choice serves the themes of redemption and consequences. Version 0.3.19 (March 2026) covers approximately 40% of the full game. The pokeemerald-expansion base ensures modern QoL features while the custom content set

games.title: Pokémon Hyper Emerald
games.developer: Destvol, Satochu, Popy, Potato, Hurricane, Feiyixiang, and others
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 5.7. Pokémon Hyper Emerald is a feature-packed Chinese ROM hack of Pokémon Emerald that has been partially translated into English. It packs an extraordinary amount of content into the Emerald engine: all 898 Pokémon up to Sword & Shield, Mega Evolution, Z-Moves, Gigantamax, 16 Gyms across the Hoenn and Sinnoh regions, and a hard mode for serious players. The game's scope is staggering. Real-time battle calculations, dynamic weather that persists outside combat, side quests with lottery mechanics, Sinnoh region town-to-town transport, Ultra Beasts, complete move animations through Gen 8, and form-changing items for key Pokémon are just some of the features. Note: The translation is ongoing and covers through Champion Island as of the latest version. Some text may still be in Chinese. Despite this, Hyper Emerald remains one of the most content-rich GBA ROM hacks ever made and is highly regarded in the community.

games.title: Pokemon Kanlara Ultimate Adventures
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Complete. Pokemon Kanlara Ultimate Adventures is a complete FireRed hack set in the Kanlara region, where Team Rocket has returned with a vengeance and threatens to take over entirely. The story follows the classic structure — receive your first Pokémon, challenge 8 gyms, battle your rival — but the Team Rocket threat escalates steadily until the entire fate of Kanlara rests in your hands. The "Ultimate" in the title reflects the polished, final version of the hack. Kanlara received multiple revisions, and this release represents the complete and most refined experience. Custom maps, original NPCs, and a well-paced story make it an accessible and satisfying playthrough. Kanlara Ultimate Adventures is ideal for players who want a classic Pokémon adventure in a new setting without the complexity of extreme difficulty hacks or sprawling multi-region maps. It's a clean, complete, enjoyable FireRed experience.

games.title: Pokemon Korosu
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version 1.0 Complete. Pokémon Korosu is creator Crizzle's darkest work — a revenge story set in the same twisted Pokémon universe as Outlaw and CAWPS. You play as a young woman who escapes captivity after her family is killed and she is enslaved by a mafia-like criminal group, setting out on a Kill Bill-inspired quest for revenge across the Sevii Islands and a corrupted, dark version of Kanto. Unlike Outlaw's crude comedy, Korosu leans into dark, violent narrative territory. The Sevii Islands have fractured into criminal fiefdoms. Kanto bears the scars of Outlaw's events. The storytelling is significantly more mature and focused than Crizzle's earlier work — it's the game he always wanted to make but had to develop the skills to execute. Warning: Contains significant violence, dark themes, and some profanity. ESRB would rate this T or M.

games.title: Pokémon Let's Go Lugia
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version 6.3. Pokémon Let's Go Lugia is a love letter to the Johto generation. Based on FireRed, its story mirrors Pokémon Soul Silver with light modifications, and the entire Pokédex is focused on Johto Pokémon and their evolutions — only 199 Pokémon total, keeping things tight and focused. The hack puts you in the shoes of either Ash (Kalos outfit) or May (Hoenn outfit), each with exclusive Pokémon available as eggs during the adventure. EXP Share is enabled by default to reduce grinding, Infinite TMs are available, and all evolutionary stones can be purchased at the Mart. The key twist: Lugia is only catchable as Ash, while Ho-Oh and Mew are exclusive to May — giving both playthroughs a unique feel. All Pokémon in the game are catchable without trading, and the Elite Four offers five rematches merged with the Battle Tower. It's a clean, accessible Johto adventure ideal for fans of Gold and Silver who want a fresh spin on familiar territory.

games.title: Pokemon Life
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Beta 1.9. Pokémon Life is a philosophical and atmospheric FireRed hack that takes a different approach to the medium. You're guided by Jirachi and Hoopa through a journey on Nendios Island that explores the nature of reality, identity, and existence. Billions of people share the world — but only a handful are "pure," and dark forces seek to manipulate or impede the pure ones. Creator Dionen created something genuinely introspective and unusual. The game uses surreal imagery, an cryptic narrative, and an emotional sensibility that stands apart from most ROM hacks. Beta 1.9 is the available version.

games.title: Pokemon Life of Guardians
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Ruby. Version Complete. Pokémon Life of Guardians is the third entry in destinedjagold's Ruby Destiny series. Set in an alternate world where Team Go-Getters accidentally changed reality, you play as a young girl who dreams of becoming a Guardian Trainer. When a Dark Organization begins threatening the region, her journey to become a Guardian becomes intertwined with the fate of the entire world. The Guardian Trainer mechanic adds a unique roleplay layer to the adventure, and the altered-world premise gives the story a distinct feel from the earlier Ruby Destiny entries. Complete and polished.

games.title: Pokemon Light Platinum
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Ruby. Version Complete. Pokémon Light Platinum is one of the most downloaded and beloved GBA ROM hacks of all time. A complete remake of Pokémon Ruby, it introduces two brand-new regions — Zhery and Lauren — and a storyline culminating in a Pokémon World Championship. Pokémon from Generations 1 through 4 are available, and the production quality was ahead of its time when originally released. Light Platinum's reputation is built on its scope and completeness. It was one of the first hacks to credibly feel like an "eighth game" in the series — a full-scale adventure with new regions, gym leaders, and an Elite Four that takes 20+ hours to complete. The World Championship post-game was particularly innovative. It remains a community classic.

games.title: Pokemon Liquid Crystal
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version 3.3 Beta. Pokémon Liquid Crystal is one of the most ambitious GBA ROM hacks ever attempted: a complete, faithful remake of the original Pokémon Crystal on GBA hardware, expanded with additional events and a brand-new region — the Orange Islands — to explore after the main story. The game covers the full Crystal storyline with new evil teams, additional rivals, and story twists woven throughout. The Orange Islands content adds significant post-game content that the original game never had. Liquid Crystal is also the foundation on which later hacks like Crystal Advance Redux were built, marking it as a cornerstone of GBA ROM hack history. Beta 3.3 is the most recent release. While the hack is in beta, it covers the complete main Johto/Kanto storyline and is fully playable.

games.title: Pokemon Mega Light Platinum
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Ruby. Version Complete. Pokémon Mega Light Platinum is an enhanced version of the legendary Pokémon Light Platinum hack, rebuilt with the addition of Mega Evolution. Light Platinum itself is one of the most popular ROM hacks ever created — a Ruby-based game featuring the Zhery and Lauren regions, Pokémon from Gens 1–5, a full Pokémon World Championship storyline, and solid production values that made it one of the first hacks to genuinely rival the official games. The Mega Evolution addition gives returning Light Platinum players new reasons to revisit the game and brings it in line with Gen 6 mechanics. If you've never played Light Platinum, this is the definitive version to play.

games.title: Pokemon Mega Power
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 5.59 COMPLETE. Pokémon Mega Power follows Neil (or Tyra), a gifted scientist obsessed with creating and enhancing Mewtwo — specifically developing a way for it to Mega Evolve without conventional Mega Stones. When funding runs dry, an offer from the mysterious Kasper of Team Delta seems like the answer. The story follows this moral ambiguity through three distinct regions: Ivara, Lande, and Sevii. The hack is built on a Wind1158-created engine similar to Pokémon Resolute and Victory Fire, and is fully complete. It's a story-driven adventure with a compelling protagonist motivation — a scientist doing questionable things for research — and delivers a satisfying multi-region journey. Good for players who want a fresh story with familiar GBA-era gameplay.

games.title: Pokemon Moon Emerald
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 0.90 Beta. Pokémon Moon Emerald follows the same story as Pokémon Emerald but with a twist: Pokémon from the seventh generation and Alolan forms have been added to the Hoenn region. The goal is to let players complete a Sideshow Showcase featuring every Alolan Pokémon within the familiar Emerald framework. It's a simple but satisfying hack for fans of Sun & Moon who want to use Alolan Pokémon in the GBA era's battle system. All Alolan captures are available throughout the game, and the Emerald story plays out as expected with these new additions woven in.

games.title: Pokemon My Ass
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Complete. Pokémon My Ass is a deliberately irreverent, comic FireRed hack where you play as a shirtless playboy recruited by Professor Oak to complete the Pokédex — while betting your "ass" in a rivalry with your chosen opponent. The tone is intentionally crude and comedic throughout. All three-generation Pokémon are available and there are six starters to choose from. The game is short, funny if you're in the right mindset, and represents a quirky corner of ROM hack history. Warning: Contains crude humor and adult language not suitable for children.

games.title: Pokemon Nameless Fire Red Project
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Complete. Pokemon Nameless Fire Red Project is a prequel and partial sequel to both Pokemon Mega Power and Pokemon Resolute — part of creator 1158's interconnected ROM hack universe. You play as Chronya, a young girl from the Cyenn Region whose mother Altena had to flee the Valo Empire under mysterious circumstances twelve years ago. The story is cinematic and character-driven. Chronya barely knows her father, barely understands why they fled, and is suddenly thrust into a conflict involving Dark Workers — agents of the Valo Emperor — and the political machinations of a crumbling empire. It's one of the more dramatically ambitious GBA hacks in the hobby. As a complete hack, Nameless offers a full journey through the Cyenn Region with a satisfying narrative payoff. Players who've already experienced Mega Power or Resolute will find extra depth in the returning characters, but Nameless stands alone as an entry point into 1158's hacking universe as well.

games.title: Pokemon Null
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 1.2. Pokemon Null is a heavily modified Pokemon Emerald ROM hack built from the ground up around the Nuzlocke format. Rather than a light reskin, it reworks the trainer roster across the entire region — 275 hand-crafted battles, each with competitive movesets, held items, and custom AI behavior designed to make every encounter a genuine threat. The Pokedex has been expanded to cover Generations 1 through 9, so the pool of available Pokemon is far larger than the original Emerald lineup. On top of that, Null adds new Mega Evolutions pulled from the Z-A era, giving veteran trainers fresh options for their final teams. To make these new additions accessible, over 50 evolutionary lines have had their evolution methods simplified, so trade evolutions, happiness checks, and other awkward requirements no longer gate access to key Pokemon. Quality-of-life is a major focus. Players get portable PC access from anywhere, an infinite Repel toggle, the ability to run everywhere (not just on designated p

games.title: Pokemon Orange Islands
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Complete. Pokemon Orange Islands is the GBA ROM hack that finally lets you relive the beloved anime arc that was never made into a mainline game. You play as Ash Ketchum following the Indigo League, sent on an errand by Professor Oak to pick up a mysterious Pokéball from Professor Ivy on Valencia Island. What follows covers nearly every episode of the Orange Islands anime arc in game form. The hack is a faithful adaptation: Misty, Tracey, Ash's iconic roster, and the four Orange Crew gym leaders are all present. Some episodes become major story beats while others are implemented as optional side quests. The Orange League itself serves as the finale, with battles against Drake and his Dragonite as the climactic showdown. For fans of the Pokémon anime who grew up watching Ash's Orange Islands journey, this hack is a nostalgic dream come true. It's a complete experience that covers the arc comprehensively and faithfully adapts the spirit of the original episodes.

games.title: Pokemon Outlaw
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version 1.0. Pokémon Outlaw is unlike any other ROM hack on this list. It's a FireRed hack that follows a 15-year-old homeless orphan living in the Kanto slums — not a wide-eyed hero heading off on a grand adventure. The Kanto you know is here, but populated with crude, violent, and darkly funny NPCs that reflect a much more realistic (and insane) version of the Pokémon world. Creator Crizzle fills the game with adult humor, unexpected plot directions, and a protagonist whose circumstances genuinely shape the tone of every interaction. It's not for children. If it were rated by ESRB it would likely be T or above. But for players who want a Pokémon game that subverts every expectation about how wholesome the series should be, Outlaw is genuinely entertaining and surprisingly well-written. Note: Contains crude humor, adult themes, and occasional offensive content. Play at your own discretion.

games.title: Pokémon Pisces
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 1.2.2. Pokémon Pisces is a bold, fully original take on the Hoenn region. Built as a decompilation of Pokémon Emerald by the Pebbler Platoon team, it strips away the familiar Hoenn map entirely and replaces it with a completely redesigned region — new routes, new cities, new layouts. The story is also new from the ground up. The standout feature is the Fakemon: over 200 original Pokémon created by the Pebbler Platoon team, the same crew behind Pokémon Altered. These Fakemon come with custom designs, cries, and movepools. Alongside the new Pokémon come a brand-new professor, male and female protagonists, and a cast of fresh NPCs. Pokémon Pisces is a fully completed game — version 1.2.2 is a polished, playable experience from start to finish. Future updates may include bug fixes but no major content additions are planned. If you're tired of playing through familiar regions and want something genuinely new, Pisces delivers.

games.title: Pokemon R.O.W.E.
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 2.1b. Pokemon R.O.W.E. (Randomized Open World Emerald) fundamentally changes how a Hoenn playthrough works by removing the linear structure of the original game. From the moment you start, every gym and every route is accessible — the world is open, and you choose where to go. Level scaling tied to your badge count keeps wild Pokemon and trainers appropriately challenging no matter what order you tackle things in. The Pokemon roster has been expanded to include Generation 8 and Generation 9 species, and a Following Pokemon mechanic lets your lead travel beside you in the overworld. At the start of the game you can pick from 9 different starters or let the game randomly assign you one, setting the tone for how much control you want over your experience. Beyond the open world, R.O.W.E. layers in a suite of optional game modes you can enable at the start of a run: Randomized (randomizes Pokemon encounters and teams), Double Battle (all trainer fights are doubles), Inverse (type matchups are rev

games.title: Pokémon Radical Red
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version 4.1. Pokémon Radical Red is the gold standard for difficulty hacks and one of the most downloaded GBA ROM hacks of all time. Built on the Complete FireRed Upgrade engine with Dynamic Pokémon Expansion, it takes the familiar Kanto region and turns it into a brutal gauntlet that demands strategy, team building, and genuine knowledge of Pokémon competitive mechanics. What sets Radical Red apart is its commitment to fairness. Every boss trainer — Gym Leaders, Elite Four, Rivals — uses fully optimized teams with perfect IVs, EVs, competitive items, and Gen 8-accurate AI. The game enforces Set battle style and restricts bag access during Gym battles, eliminating the ability to cheese fights with items. A built-in soft level cap prevents over-leveling, meaning you can't just grind your way to victory. At the same time, Radical Red gives you every tool you need to succeed. All Pokémon up to Gen 9 are obtainable, including Hisuian, Galarian, and Alolan forms, plus Paradox Pokémon. Every move and abi

games.title: Pokemon Reign of Legends
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Ruby. Version Complete. Pokémon Reign of Legends is the first entry in destinedjagold's Ruby Destiny series, set in the brand-new Gento region. You and your neighbor receive Pokémon from Professor Redwood and set out to become Champion — but two rival factions, Royal Darkness and Luminous Cenaries, are fighting for control of the region, and a growing darkness threatens the world. The Ruby Destiny series was a landmark achievement in early ROM hacking for its custom maps, original story, and polished execution. Reign of Legends introduces the region and cast that the series builds on across multiple games. It's a complete, classic story-driven GBA adventure.

games.title: Pokemon Rescue Rangers
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Ruby. Version Complete. Pokémon Rescue Rangers is the second entry in destinedjagold's Ruby Destiny series. A supernatural force transports you to the Pokémon world as a Pikachu, where you join a Rescue Team alongside a Torchic and Chikorita. It's a Mystery Dungeon-inspired premise fused with a classic RPG structure — you play as a human-turned-Pokémon with no memory of their past life. The game builds on the world established in Reign of Legends and adds emotional depth through the fish-out-of-water protagonist. It's complete and offers a solid, story-focused adventure for fans of the Pokémon world's lore and characters.

games.title: Pokemon Resolute
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 2.7.8 COMPLETE. Pokémon Resolute follows Logan (or Alma) from Cedar City as they begin a Pokémon journey through the Sylon Region — only to become entangled in the re-emergence of Team Mirage, a disbanded criminal organization that claims to have reformed. Should you trust them? The story makes this central tension the driving force of the adventure. Resolute is part of Wind1158's interconnected trilogy alongside Victory Fire and Mega Power. The Sylon Region is brand new, and the game is fully completed at version 2.7.8. It's a solid story-driven adventure with clean GBA-era gameplay and a memorable cast of characters.

games.title: Pokemon Rijon Adventures
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Beta. Pokémon Rijon Adventures is a FireRed-based hack set in the Rijon region, south of Johto. You travel to Rijon to follow in your father's footsteps and become the League Champion, twenty years after your father battled the region's champion and became his best friend. Rijon is one of the older ROM hacks in this collection and represents a classic example of early-era custom region hacking. It's a Beta release with straightforward gameplay and a charming nostalgic feel.

games.title: Pokémon Rocket Edition
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Final 1.02. Pokémon Rocket Edition is one of the most acclaimed story-driven ROM hacks ever made. It retells the events of Pokémon FireRed from the perspective of a Team Rocket grunt, exposing the dark underbelly of the story that Red never sees — sociopathic scientists, corrupt Gym Leaders, revenge-driven nurses, and a criminal hierarchy full of secrets. The game's morality system lets you make choices that affect the story and open branching sidequests, giving it real replayability. You can steal Pokémon from every single Trainer in the game. The writing is exceptional — genuinely engaging, darkly funny in places, and narratively coherent in a way that makes you see the original FireRed story in a completely different light. Along the way, you'll uncover the connections between Lance, Giovanni, and Professor Oak, learn what really happened during the Great Pokémon War, and discover the fate of the hundreds of Trainers Red ruthlessly defeated. An essential play for anyone who has ever wondered wh

games.title: Pokemon Saffron
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Demo 2. Pokemon Saffron is a FireRed hack set in the Azira region — a lush, migration-centric land in South America where the Great Migration event draws trainers, researchers, and adventurers from across the Pokémon world once every decade. You've moved from Hoenn with your mother following in your brother's footsteps, and Professor Oak himself recruits you to study the mysterious connection between migration routes and legendary Pokémon. Saffron has a breezy, adventure-forward tone that distinguishes it from darker story-driven hacks. The world feels warm and inviting, the regional Pokémon density is high due to the migration theme, and the presence of familiar faces (Team Rocket, Professor Oak) grounds the new setting in recognizable mythology. Currently at Demo 2, Saffron offers a polished slice of what promises to be a full-featured hack. The mapping quality, writing, and world design are notably strong for a fan project, making it worth playing even in its unfinished state.

games.title: Pokemon Saiph
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Complete. Pokemon Saiph is a FireRed hack set in the Colen Region — a land established as an emergency evacuation site after a catastrophic explosion at Old Mauville destroyed West Hoenn. The lore is deeply tied to Pokémon Rangers: Shadows of Almia, making it a rare hack that builds on a spin-off game's canon. Ten years after the evacuation, you're old enough to start your Pokémon journey in Colen. But Team Void — a mysterious organization with ties to the Shadow Crystal and Darkrai — has other plans. The story is complex, the region is fully realized, and the connection to Pokémon mythology gives Saiph a depth rare in fan-made games. Pokemon Saiph is a complete experience from start to finish, with polished maps, custom events, and a narrative that rewards players who know their Pokémon lore. It was followed by Pokemon Saiph 2, so there's more of the story to explore after finishing this entry.

games.title: Pokemon Saiph 2
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version 1.4.0. Pokemon Saiph 2 is the direct sequel to Pokemon Saiph and the third entry in Vytron's VytroVerse saga. Picking up after the events of Saiph, the story moves to the Rikoto Region — a new custom region with fresh maps, characters, and a deepened narrative that rewards players who experienced the first game. The VytroVerse games are notable for their serious storytelling and interconnected lore, rare qualities in ROM hacks. Saiph 2 expands on the Shadow Crystal mythology introduced in the first game and gives the world more room to breathe. Version 1.4.0 is the most recent release, with both English and Spanish language support. If you haven't played Pokemon Saiph, it's strongly recommended to play it first — the story of Saiph 2 assumes familiarity with the events of the original. Together, the two games form one of the most cohesive multi-part storytelling achievements in GBA ROM hacking.

games.title: Pokemon Shiny Gold
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Beta 5. Pokémon Shiny Gold is one of the most celebrated early GBA ROM hacks — a FireRed-based remake of Pokémon Gold set in the Johto region, predating the official HeartGold/SoulSilver remakes by years. Created by Zel, it captured the hearts of players who wanted to experience Johto with GBA-era graphics and gameplay improvements. Shiny Gold delivers the classic Gold story with a fresh coat of paint, improved battle mechanics over the GBC original, and enough additions and polish to feel like a genuine upgrade. Beta 5 is the final available version. While HeartGold/SoulSilver have since become the official remakes, Shiny Gold holds significant nostalgic and historical value as the fan remake that proved it could be done.

games.title: Pokemon Shiny Gold Sigma
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version 1.3 Complete. Pokémon Shiny Gold Sigma is the most expansive entry in the Shiny Gold series. Co-created by Alex and Zel, it adds 850+ Pokémon, Mega Evolution, the full Kanto region, the Orange Archipelago, and a Battle Frontier to the Johto base. It's a complete overhaul that transforms Shiny Gold from a Johto remake into a multi-region mega-hack. With Gen 1 through 6 Pokémon available and all the modern battle mechanics to match, Shiny Gold Sigma is arguably the definitive version of the Shiny Gold experience — more content, more Pokémon, and more post-game than any earlier entry in the series.

games.title: Pokemon Shiny Gold X
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Beta 5. Pokémon Shiny Gold X is an enhanced difficulty version of the Shiny Gold hack, featuring stronger trainers, higher-level Pokémon, and a tougher overall challenge. If you've already played through Shiny Gold and want to revisit the Johto story with a real test of your skills, this is the version to play. All the content from Shiny Gold is present — the same Johto region, improved GBA graphics, and classic story — but every trainer fight will push you harder. Expect to grind and team-build more carefully than in the standard version.

games.title: Pokemon Sienna
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Complete. Pokémon Sienna takes the familiar Kanto setting from FireRed and injects a fresh story and antagonist faction. After being rejected from the Indigo Plateau trainer school due to lack of experience, your character sets out independently to earn 8 Gym Badges — while simultaneously dealing with a mysterious criminal team causing havoc across the region. The game adds meaningful choices to the narrative: you can choose how to interact with the villainous team, adding a light moral dimension rarely seen in ROM hacks of this era. The game is now fully complete, with a final bugfix patch released in April 2025.

games.title: Pokemon Sky Twilight
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Beta 3. Pokemon Sky Twilight is a FireRed hack set in the Crocus Region — a diverse and colorful land known for its rare Pokémon population, including the legendary Noivern, one of the rarest Pokémon in the region. When Team Voltage kidnaps rare Pokémon and forces them to Mega Evolve as a power source, it falls to you — a trainer from Begonia Village — to stop them. Sky Twilight captures the optimistic spirit of classic Pokémon adventures. You'll travel through the Crocus Region's varied environments, earn 8 gym badges, and face off against the Elite Four while dismantling Team Voltage's operations. Mega Evolution plays a central role in both the story and the gameplay. Currently at Beta 3, Sky Twilight offers a substantial amount of content and is well-suited for players who want a traditional region-spanning Pokémon experience in a fresh setting. It's a fan project with genuine heart and an appealing cast of custom Pokémon encounters.

games.title: Pokemon Snakewood
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Ruby. Version Complete. Pokémon Snakewood is one of the most memorable and unusual ROM hacks ever made. It's a post-apocalyptic survival horror story set in Hoenn after a zombie invasion. You wake in a ruined Littleroot Town with no memory, and must journey through a Hoenn overrun by the undead — fighting zombies, witches, demons, the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse, and eventually the architect of the disaster: the villain Senex. Snakewood is known for its bizarre, unpredictable humor alongside its dark themes — the "Deadly Seven" NPCs are cheerfully insane, and creator Cutlerine has a distinctive voice that makes the writing consistently entertaining despite the grim premise. Completely unique in tone, setting, and atmosphere, Snakewood remains one of the most unforgettable GBA ROM hacks ever made.

games.title: Pokemon Sun Ruby
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Ruby. Version Complete. Pokémon Sun Ruby replaces Groudon with Solgaleo and adds Pokémon from the seventh generation into the familiar Ruby story. Thirty-six Gen 7 Pokémon are catchable, fourteen Alolan forms are available, and the three Alolan starters can be obtained. Evolution stones are conveniently available for purchase in Mauville City. It's a straightforward but satisfying Gen 7 injection into a Gen 3 game — ideal for players who want to use Sun & Moon favorites in the GBA engine without a more complex hack.

games.title: Pokemon Sunset Orange
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version 1.0 Alpha. Pokémon Sunset Orange is a Fire Red hack that faithfully recreates the Pokémon Orange Islands anime arc as a playable GBA game. You play as Ash Ketchum, who has just returned from the Indigo League and is sent by Professor Oak to retrieve a special Poké Ball from Valencia Island — kicking off the same adventure fans watched in the anime. Nearly all major Orange Islands episodes are covered, from the Orange Crew Gym battles to the final showdown with the Orange League Champion. It's an Alpha version, so expect the adventure to cover the opening arc before the story concludes. A great pick for fans who grew up watching the anime and want to relive those moments in game form.

games.title: Pokemon Sweet
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version Complete. Pokémon Sweet is one of the most charming and inventive ROM hacks ever made. Every single Pokémon has been replaced with a "PokéSweet" — a candy-themed creature that looks and behaves like a dessert. The type chart is entirely redesigned around twelve ice cream flavors (Apple is totally a flavor of ice cream, the creator insists). The result is something genuinely delightful and unlike any other ROM hack. The game takes place in a world that "totally isn't Kanto" and rewards thorough exploration with hidden items and cleverly placed surprises around every corner. Creator Ephraim225 clearly had fun with the premise, filling the game with puns and in-jokes that land consistently. It's a complete experience and a beloved classic in the ROM hack community.

games.title: Pokemon Sweet 2th
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version COMPLETED. Pokémon Sweet 2th is the fully realized sequel to the original Sweet, built with two years of additional experience and community input. It features a brand-new region (not just a reskin of Kanto like the original), more than double the number of PokéSweets, and a few unexpected twists that veteran Sweet players won't see coming. Creator Ephraim225 designed 2th to be the definitive candy-Pokémon experience — a complete, polished game built on fan art and fan sprites that poured in after the original. It's longer, more varied, and more ambitious than its predecessor while keeping the same whimsical, pun-dense humor that made Sweet a community favorite.

games.title: Pokémon Sword and Shield Ultimate Plus
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version 1.2.1.1. Pokémon Sword and Shield Ultimate Plus is one of the most ambitious demakes ever attempted — a faithful recreation of the full Pokémon Sword and Shield experience on GBA hardware, built by Pclg, Jeanstars, and Phantonomy. The game covers the complete Galar Gym Challenge storyline, the Isle of Armor post-game, and the Crown Tundra — all playable on a GBA emulator. Generation 1 through 8 Pokémon are available, including the Hydrapple line, Archeludon, and Hisui starters. Dynamax, Gigantamax, Mega Evolution, and Z-Moves are all implemented. A portable PC, Fly Map, and DexNav in the menu make traversal painless. With new music, new side quests, and a post-game Legendary Hunt on top of two full expansion areas, Sword and Shield Ultimate Plus packs an enormous amount of content into the GBA format. If you want to experience Galar without a Switch, this is the best option available.

games.title: Pokemon Theta Emerald EX
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version Complete. Pokémon Theta Emerald EX is a feature-enhancement hack of Pokémon Emerald that keeps the original story entirely intact while adding a comprehensive package of modern Pokémon mechanics. No story changes, no new regions — just Hoenn as you know it, powered up with everything players wished Emerald had. Key features include Mega Evolution, all Fairy-type moves and type matchups, Physical/Special split, all Pokémon from Gens 1–6, hidden abilities, updated Pokémon sprites, Move Deleter/Reminder NPCs, and new evolution methods for previously trade-only Pokémon. It's the Emerald experience fully modernized — a great choice for players who want to replay Hoenn with all the tools of a contemporary Pokémon game.

games.title: Pokemon Too Many Types 2
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Emerald. Version 1.5.2. Pokemon Too Many Types 2 is the sequel to the original Too Many Types, a ROM hack by Too Many Productions (directed by Jacob Alpharad) that fundamentally reworks how the type system operates. Where vanilla Emerald has 18 types, this hack expands the total to 80 — with 30 types making their debut in this sequel — and allows any Pokemon to hold up to three types at once rather than the standard two. The story begins in a changed version of Hoenn two years after the events of the first game. The player moves to Lilycove Town and explores a region that has shifted significantly to reflect how the expanded type ecosystem has evolved the world and its Pokemon. For battles, 131 new moves have been added alongside 17 new mega evolutions, giving teams a much wider toolkit than standard Emerald provides. The regional dex contains 398 Pokemon, and soft level caps combined with level scaling keep encounters feeling appropriately challenging throughout the run. The EV system has been cut entirely —

games.title: Pokemon Ultra Shiny Gold Sigma
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version 1.5.1. Pokemon Ultra Shiny Gold Sigma is the latest and most ambitious entry in Alex Sanchez's long-running Shiny Gold series — an evolution so substantial it earned a new name. Built on the same FireRed foundation as its predecessors, Ultra Shiny Gold Sigma pushes the GBA engine to its absolute limits. The headline feature is Generation IX content: Pokémon from Scarlet and Violet, including Terastallization, are playable in a GBA game. With 900+ Pokémon available across the full game spanning Johto, Kanto, the Orange Islands, and a Battle Frontier, the scale is extraordinary. Version 1.5.1 (January 2024) is the most recent release, bringing updated sprites, balance fixes, and expanded content. If you've played any previous Shiny Gold game, Ultra Sigma makes everything before it feel like a demo. It's the definitive GBA Johto experience for players who want maximum content.

games.title: Pokemon Ultra Violet
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version 1.22. Pokémon Ultra Violet is a quality-of-life improvement hack of Pokémon FireRed with one primary goal: let a solo player catch all Pokémon from the first two generations without trading. In vanilla FireRed, version-exclusive and trade-evolution Pokémon require a second game or trading partner — Ultra Violet removes that restriction entirely. Beyond that, the game stays close to the original FireRed experience with small improvements to trainer teams and encounter locations. It's an excellent choice for players who want to complete the original 251 Pokémon Pokédex in a single playthrough on a single device.

games.title: Pokémon Unbound
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version 2.1.1.1. Pokémon Unbound is widely regarded as one of the best Pokémon GBA ROM hacks ever made, and for good reason. Developed by Skeli over several years, it transforms Pokémon Fire Red into a feature-rich RPG set in the brand-new Borrius region — complete with an original story, a fully original soundtrack of over 180 songs, and production values that rival official Pokémon games. The game's standout feature is its four difficulty modes: Easy, Normal, Challenging, and Insane. Whether you're a casual player who wants to relax and enjoy the story or a hardcore Pokémon fan looking for the ultimate test of skill, Unbound has a mode for you. At Insane difficulty, every Gym Leader and Elite 4 member uses optimized teams with perfect IVs, EVs, and competitive movesets — a true test of your Pokémon knowledge. Beyond difficulty, Unbound is packed with content. There are over 80 missions to complete, daily events scattered across Borrius, three unique mini-games (Cloud Burst, Safari Sniper, Underground

games.title: Pokémon Unbound Battle Frontier
games.description: Base game: Pokémon Fire Red. Version 2.0.1. Pokémon Unbound Battle Frontier is a standalone demo that lets you jump straight into the Borrius Battle Frontier from Pokémon Unbound — no need to play through the full game first.
